paragraphs: Maximus sells technology and program operations to government agencies working in health, human services, veteran support, citizen experience, defense, and national security. Homepage headings group the work as technology services, customer experience, health and clinical services, and program delivery. Named offerings include omnichannel contact center solutions for federal and state agencies, tools to reduce SNAP error rates and case backlogs, and veteran services delivered through AI and digital transformation.

The case studies page lists state work, including a SNAP surge in Wisconsin and SNAP replacement benefits delivered in Texas after natural disasters. Another case study says the Texas Health and Human Services Commission contracted Maximus to integrate eligibility support services for TANF, SNAP, Medicaid, and CHIP. Other entries describe centralized credentialing for Medicaid provider networks in Ohio and a transition from the federal exchange to a state-based marketplace for Maine.

Federal examples on the same page include an AI-Powered Medical Records Processing System for disability benefits applications at the VA. The page also credits Maximus with supporting the modernization of HRSA’s Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network. Another entry says automation helped CMS streamline No Surprises Act case processing.

quote.text: Government agencies choose Maximus because we deliver results where mission, technology, and operations intersect.
